subject: Final commitment sequence — authorization window & day-0 startslot
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@zephir.ai>, Rachel Lowe <rachel.lowe@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final commitment sequence — authorization window & day-0 startslot

Hi Asha / Rachel —

Thanks again for a productive week of evals. Attached is the updated MAP (MAP_Zephir_v3.xlsx) and our SOW redline summary (SOW_Stellar_redline_v2.pdf). This thread is to lock the final go/no-go timing and the signature window so we can confirm the customer-facing start date. 

High-level proposal: 
- Exec approval & internal OK: target by Thu 22 Jul EOD PT
- Legal & procurement routing (DocuSign): 48-hour e-sign window starting Fri 23 Jul 09:00 PT
- Provisioning & staging: provisioned Mon 26 Jul, shadow traffic Tue 27 Jul
- Day-0 start: Wed 28 Jul (soft launch with limited traffic)

Requests for you: 
1) Please confirm the signature window above works for your procurement/legal team (we can shift ±48 hours).
2) Confirm the target day-0 start date or propose an alternate date and which time zone you prefer (we'll coordinate cutover times).
3) Any final MAP deliverables you want added before we route? We captured success criteria, rollback gates, and a 7-day monitoring plan.

Attachments: MAP_Zephir_v3.xlsx (planning sheet), SOW_Stellar_redline_v2.pdf (redlines inline)

If it helps, we can do a 15-min alignment call tomorrow to confirm signer set and DocuSign recipients.

Thanks —
Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
minah@redwood.ai

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@zephir.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rachel Lowe <rachel.lowe@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Final commitment sequence — authorization window & day-0 startslot

Mina —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Quick notes from our side after a fast sync with procurement/legal: 
- We can make the 23 Jul 09:00 PT e-sign window work but need to lock the signer list by end of day Wed 21 Jul so our internal approvers can be looped.
- Question on SOW redlines: section 3.2 (data residency) — our security team asked whether the private deployment option can be staged in our us-west region rather than shared-hosted. That will affect the provisioning timeline by ~2 business days.
- Success criteria look good; can we add a brief clause for automated log export cadence (daily) for the first 14 days?

We should be able to meet the Day-0 target if we confirm signer set by Wed. If you prefer we can move the e-sign window to Mon 26 Jul to give us extra slack (but would push Day-0 to 29 Jul).

Asha
Asha Patel
Head of Platform Ops
Zephir.ai
asha.patel@zephir.ai

Folks —

Internal check: Exec (Vivek) has given conditional approval pending legal sign-off. Legal and finance have reviewed the latest redline and accept the private deployment ask in us-west provided the small amendment below is accepted: the temporary staging cluster will be on dedicated capacity and will be included in the invoice as an initial setup line item (one-time). We updated the SOW with that language in a separate redline (attached to my note in the document).

We commit to the following routing steps: 
- Wed 21 Jul 16:00 PT: Redwood will provide final signer list and seed DocuSign recipients
- Fri 23 Jul 09:00 PT: DocuSign envelope opens (48-hour window) — if Zephir prefers Mon 26 Jul, advise by 17:00 PT Thu 22 Jul
- Mon 26 Jul 11:00 PT: Redwood provisioning begins (us-west dedicated pool)
- Wed 28 Jul 09:00 PT: Soft launch (Day-0) with agreed success gates

Camila and I will prep the DocuSign envelope once we receive the final signer list. Asha — please confirm by EOD Wed whether you want the 23 Jul or the 26 Jul e-sign start. If you pick 23 Jul, we need the signer list by EOD Wed.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
